nodes.name: Every weekday, 08:00
nodes.notes: 08:00 Mon-Fri. The workflow's own timezone setting governs this; TIMEZONE in config governs which calendar day the log is keyed on. Set both to the same zone.

nodes.name: [cred] Sheets - read the log
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData is on. Without it a log holding only a header row ends the run here with a green tick and no explanation.

nodes.name: draft today?
nodes.notes: The four-state machine in §7 of the Hermes setup doc. The LOG decides, never the presence of a rendered file.

nodes.name: [cred] Sheets - read the bank
nodes.notes: Skipped entirely when SHEET_ID is blank - the demo bank in config is used instead, so the whole pipeline runs with no Google account.

nodes.name: caption needed?
nodes.notes: A row that already carries a caption goes straight through. The model is only ever asked for a caption that does not exist yet - it never rewrites copy a person approved.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('config').first().json.llm_model, stream: false, max_tokens: 1200, temperature: 0.7, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json._llm_system }, { role: 'user', content: $json._llm_user }] }) }}

nodes.name: [cred] LLM - write the caption
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible. stream:false matters - the gateway streams by default and n8n cannot read a streamed body. A failure here is not fatal: the next node treats a missing caption as a hold, not a crash.

nodes.name: which renderer?
nodes.notes: Adding a provider is a branch here plus a block in 'build the render request'. Never add one that renders from a URL - the template is not hosted anywhere, and hosting it to satisfy a renderer publishes an unapproved draft.

nodes.name: [cred] Browserless - HTML to PNG
nodes.notes: Returns the PNG bytes directly. Self-host it beside n8n - the docker-compose service block is in the README.

nodes.name: [cred] HCTI - HTML to image
nodes.notes: Returns JSON { url }. The next node downloads it.

nodes.name: image usable?
nodes.notes: Checks the PNG signature and the IHDR dimensions in the bytes, not the HTTP status. A renderer that answers 200 with a JSON error, or with a blank canvas, is a failure that looks like success.

nodes.name: deliver it?
nodes.notes: False in PREVIEW, which is how this ships. Everything above has already run, so the rendered PNG is in this execution to look at.

nodes.name: [cred] Discord - deliver the draft
nodes.notes: The draft and nothing else goes here. No slot number, no run id, no reasoning about why this post was chosen - the reviewer is looking at the post, not at the workflow. ATTACH THE PNG: set the node's 'Files' option to the binary property `data`. A draft that arrives without its image means the bot is missing Attach Files, and the reviewer is approving something they cannot see.

nodes.name: row for the log
nodes.notes: Written AFTER the delivery succeeds, never before. A row saying a draft is awaiting approval when none was delivered silences tomorrow too, and nothing ever clears it.

nodes.name: [cred] Slack - post the summary
nodes.notes: Never carries the caption. A draft that reaches a second audience before it is approved has left the approval gate behind.

parameters.content:
## 1 of 2 — draft and approve

Every weekday at 08:00 this picks the next post from the bank, writes or reads its caption,
renders the image, and puts the draft in Discord for a human to approve.

**It never publishes.** Publishing is `02-publish-on-approval.json`, and it only happens
after somebody replies `post`.

**Ships in PREVIEW.** Nothing leaves the building until you set `TEST_CHANNEL_ID`, and
nothing reaches LinkedIn until `TEST_RUN = false` in workflow 02. Two separate acts.

### The image

There is no browser in n8n, so this is one call out to a renderer.

`browserless` self-hosted next to n8n is the shipped answer — the compose service block is
in the README.

**No fallback to an image model.** This canvas is a logo, a headline and small body copy,
which is exactly what an image model cannot be trusted with. A failed render is a failure.

### The approval gate

Anyone who can send a message in this channel can publish to the company page. Use a private
channel made for this and nothing else.

Set the Discord node's **Files** option to the binary property `data` so the PNG is attached.
A draft with no image is one the reviewer cannot actually review.
